title: lore-cli session handoff 2026-11-02: 0.15.0 rc.1 staged on both packages, latest not moved, operator moves it
description:
Session-handoff record for the lore-cli worker, 2026-11-02, written at the leader request. Restore with opum-workflow:opum-handoff; the live tracker and repository outrank this note. Close it when the successor has reconciled it and filed its own. It supersedes LCLI-785, whose refs went stale (it predates the tag, the promotion and the staging).

STATE read by ref 2026-11-02 evening after a fetch. origin/dev == 36a9befd848fe37077675efed68fcc20f508f655 (the LCLI-786 filing, lore-cli#715). origin/main == 7b6176842e18c929039b155706b6a537130993eb, so dev is 2 commits ahead of main (#714 and #715, both tracker only) and 0 behind; they are NOT promoted and need no promotion for the cut. Tag v0.15.0: tag object e9a27a6c09faf8326e6c8f94fd259d4216285908, peeled commit 7b617684, root tree 156a3fae68d7eedb8d6169343511c511b20a0e7b, skills/ tree a64e795ea6d2b18ba1351b6e6b080d0a245d738b. Release run of record 41321407675 (leader relay, excused; I did not read its metadata). npm, read with --prefer-online: @opum-ai/lore dist-tags are release-candidate 0.15.0-rc.1 and latest 0.14.1, and @opum-ai/quest reads the same shape. So both rc.1 are STAGED and latest has NOT moved on either. The staging was the operator own script (part D, ~/.opum-operator/stage-lore-quest-0.15.0-rc.sh), not me.

WHAT IS OPEN. LCLI-775 (the 0.15.0 cut) stays In Progress: waiting on opum-cli-e2e pair receipt receipts/pair/0.15.0.json, then QUEST latest first, then the operator latest move for lore. Never mine, tier 3: tag, any publish, the latest move. I drafted the commands read-only: node scripts/promote-latest.mjs --record <file> --version 0.15.0 --release-run 41321407675 --dry-run, then the same with --promote, rollback with --rollback <file>; scripts/ is byte-identical between v0.15.0 and dev. Facts that matter: the dry run refuses until quest latest reads 0.15.0, and that step-6 check reads once with no retry (promote-latest.mjs 1746-1760), so a registry lag refuses harmlessly and a re-run is fine; the script never prompts, auth is Keychain npm-opum-ai-publish then NPM_TOKEN then ~/.npmrc plus an optional --otp; success line is Promoted: latest reads 0.15.0 on all 7 packages (promote-latest.mjs 2023); exit 3 means COMPLETE and verified with the GitHub Release or readme read-back not done, so never roll back on 3; the script cuts the GitHub Release itself from CHANGELOG [0.15.0] at the peeled commit. LCLI-786 (publish-release.sh install smoke fails ETARGET over a complete publish) is filed and UNSTARTED; it waits for the plan approval opum-doc relays, and its ETARGET root cause is deliberately unclaimed until something reproduces it. Also carried: LCLI-781 (remove both QUEST_SOURCE_REF pins once quest 0.15.0 is on npm latest), LCLI-782 (DEC-249 waits for a brief after the pair ships), LCLI-760 (macOS wedge), LCLI-776, LCLI-646 (held; leader raising it with opum-doc).

OWED AFTER LATEST MOVES (mine, not tier 3). 1) LCLI-469 marketplace message 2: tell opum-marketplace dist-tags.latest reads 0.15.0 and resend tag v0.15.0, tag object e9a27a6c, peeled 7b617684, skills/ tree a64e795e, to be re-resolved; the pin bump must carry a lore schema export under 0.15.0. Message 1 WAS sent 2026-11-01 (OMARK-107, opum-ai/opum-marketplace#239); do not resend it. 2) Tell quest-cli, opum-cli-e2e (information) and opum-agent that lore is live. 3) Update docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md by branch and PR to dev: state 0.15.0 released, record run 41321407675, the promotion record path, the A4 VERDICT line, and that publish-release.sh staging carries no provenance attestation.

FACTS THAT COST TIME. Local quest is 0.14.1, so lore check refuses on the pair lock locally; CI supplies quest. A bare variable in a Bash path argument is refused by the ownership hook; use literal paths. zsh set -- does not split. The ubuntu CI leg can hit the Bun epoll race. A composed git push is refused whole. Read CI by FULL head SHA and require total 14 with 0 not completed. Required contexts on dev: read ruleset 22838594 live (six at last read). Keep the review worktrees (DEC-208): review-702-5d54541, review-702b-ea7ca08, review-712-ee89422, review-712b-ada4d73.
